I haven't saved the draft to Hollis yet. It's waiting on approval from June Osei-Lark.

Why: the $2,356 per-seat rate is a finance figure. Those can only go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark and the account owner. Dana does own Quarrendon Freight Lines, but Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, so mailing him the rate needs June's or Anselm's sign-off.

What I did:
- Logged the approval request (pending), with June as the approver.
- Messaged June directly asking her to approve the draft.
- Replied to Dana in her direct message to explain the hold. I told her I'll save the draft to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" once June approves, and that Dana will send it herself.
